Check mortality data for common problems

Source: R/data-validate.R
mt_validate.Rd

Runs plausibility checks and returns one row per finding:

Usage

mt_validate(data, hierarchy = NULL, tol = 0.005)

Arguments

data

An mt_data object.

hierarchy

Optional mt_hierarchy(), or a list with var (stratum column) and total (value of the total).

tol

Relative tolerance for hierarchy sums.

Value

A data.table of class mt_validation with columns check, severity, measure, stratum, n, detail.

Details

  • deaths with zero exposure in the same cell (error);

  • central death rates above 1 below age 100 (warning);

  • missing values (warning);

  • strata without any value of a measure, for example without deaths (warning);

  • levels that look like totals of other levels of the same variable, for example "Insgesamt" or "all" among the regions (warning);

  • zero exposures (info);

  • grid cells without deaths or exposures (info);

  • hierarchy sums, when hierarchy is given (mt_hierarchy()): every aggregate stratum in the data is compared with the sum of its bottom strata per cell, for deaths and exposures (exposures are summed over the variables whose exposures add up and taken once over those whose levels share an exposure, such as causes of death).

Examples

mt_validate(mt_example())
#> <mt_validation> no findings
